title: SAST list: scans from a zip upload show "—" as their source
body:
**Severity:** low. The Source column on the SAST list shows "—" for zip uploads instead of "Zip file".

**Evidence.** Content review of PR #38, tip `sast.table.source` (`infotips.ts:324`): the list-item builder sets no source label for zip uploads.

**Fix.** Return a "Zip file" source label for zip-upload scans; add a list-item test.

Found by the content-accuracy review of PR #38 (review 5858670025). Evidence scripts: session scratchpad `round6/rv-content38-probe/`.
